description: Get a pre-reasoned market briefing with trends and confidence scores, plus regime classification and a rule based note on what moved with the price in the briefings that carry them, for the requested domain (macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, a listed company, cross-asset or Bitcoin; the same families as the server instructions). Includes macro financial data, cross-asset correlations (equity indices, volatility, the dollar and Treasury yields, each beside Bitcoin) and crypto. Output is written to be read directly by reasoning agents, not parsed for individual values. Briefings are tier-gated: Free (btc.quick-check, btc.context, macro.snapshot, cross.correlations, btc.pulse, btc.grid-stress), Basic (btc.momentum, macro.liquidity, macro.auctions, macro.calendar, btc.on-chain, cross.breadth, btc.miner-survival, btc.etf-flows, commodities.gold, commodities.silver, commodities.copper, commodities.wheat, eth.context, bonds.context, equities.company), Pro (cross.ai-compute, macro.rates, btc.full, btc.factors, cross.regime, fx.liquidity, btc.energy, btc.treasury, commodities.energy-basket, commodities.oil-producers, commodities.gold-miners, commodities.grains-agribusiness, bonds.full). Needs a PreReason account: a signed in connection or an API key.

block.description: One part of the company briefing, with entity (for example "valuation" or "against_guidance"); today only, except "numbers", which also takes date (its figures as known on that day). Leave out for the whole briefing. A part counts one call; the whole briefing counts one for each part it carries.

date.description: A past date, YYYY-MM-DD: the briefing as of the end of that day (UTC; a company's numbers at the end of the day in its own market), for the periods released by then. Each figure says when it was public, or that it may be a later revision PreReason holds in its place. For a period's latest figures, including later corrections, leave date out. Tier-gated: Free=30d; Basic=3y, Bitcoin briefings from Jan 2025; Pro=all. A company briefing takes one only with block "numbers".

entity.description: The company for a per company briefing: a USA ticker or CIK (NVDA), a Japanese securities code (7203), a Korean stock code (005930), an Indian company's ISIN (INE018A01030) or the LEI of a company filing in the UK or of a European company (2138002P5RNKC5W2JZ46), with briefing=equities.company

format.description: Response format: markdown (human-readable, default) or json (structured data)

history.description: With block "numbers" alone: the numbers block with its core lines over the last eight quarters, or the half years a company files instead, and five fiscal years, as filed. One call; never part of the whole briefing.

name: get_context
title: Get Market Briefing
